0022600006.text: The Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against a Philadelphia team that has not yet played this season, and Cleveland will be without Khalifa Diop (knee), Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back), and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness), all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles. The 2025-26 season series ended with the Cavaliers winning 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 115-101 win in Cleveland on March 9, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Cleveland a 40% chance to win.
